title: Claim Coverage Credit on the Mold Remediation Signing Deposit
content:
An insurance claim funded Mold Remediation job pays the signing deposit reduced by its coverage credit, and a self-pay job pays it in full. The coverage credit is read from the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job.

**Coverage credit.** A job linked to a claim file in approved status whose mold sublimit is above 0.00 takes a coverage credit equal to that mold sublimit; a job linked to a claim file in estimate submitted status whose mold sublimit is above 0.00 takes a coverage credit of 50 percent (the pending credit percentage) of that mold sublimit, rounded to the cent, half up; a job with no linked claim file, a claim file in any other status, or a mold sublimit of 0.00 takes no coverage credit.

| Linked claim file status | Mold sublimit | Coverage credit |
|---|---|---|
| Approved | Above 0.00 | The whole mold sublimit |
| Estimate submitted | Above 0.00 | 50 percent of the mold sublimit, rounded to the cent, half up |
| Approved or estimate submitted | 0.00 | None |
| Opened, settled, closed, denied or withdrawn | Any | None |
| No linked claim file | — | None |

Hypothetical figures: an approved file with a mold sublimit of 2600.00 gives a credit of 2600.00; an estimate submitted file with a mold sublimit of 1555.55 gives 50 percent of it, 777.775, rounded half up to 777.78.
